ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a positive-edge-triggered D Flip-Flop, the input is D_in, the clock CK is connected to the CLK terminal, and the output Q together with D_in is connected to an XOR gate, whose output node is labeled X. The waveform diagram on the right shows that the period of CK is T_CK, the transition of D_in has a delay interval ΔT relative to the sampling clock edge, and ΔT and T_CK are marked in the figure. Reasoning: If D_in does not transition within a certain clock cycle, then the Q of the ideal flip-flop remains the same sampled data, D_in and Q are the same, and the XOR output X is low level 0 V. If D_in transitions within a certain clock cycle, then before the next positive clock edge after the transition, Q still holds the old value, while D_in has changed to the new value, so D_in and Q are different, and the XOR outputs high level. According to the given method, the high-level duration is T_CK - ΔT. Given ΔT/T_CK = 0.15, therefore the high-level duty cycle when a transition occurs is 1 - 0.15 = 0.85. The probability that D_in transitions in each cycle is 0.3, so the average high-level time ratio is 0.3 × 0.85 = 0.255. The XOR high-level voltage is 3.3 V, therefore the average voltage of X is 3.3 × 0.255 = 0.8415 V, and retaining two decimal places gives 0.84 V.

raw_record.question_text:
In the figure, the circuit shown is a positive edge-triggered D Flip-Flop used for sampling input data \( D_{in} \) using clock CK. The XOR gate outputs 3.3 volts for logic HIGH and 0 volts for logic LOW levels. The data bit and clock periods are equal, and the value of \( \Delta T / T_{CK} = 0.15 \), where the parameters \( \Delta T \) and \( T_{CK} \) are shown in the figure. Assume that the Flip-Flop and the XOR gate are ideal.

If the probability of input data bit \( D_{in} \) transition in each clock period is 0.3, the average value (in volts, accurate to two decimal places) of the voltage at node \( X \) is ______.

method.method_draft: For a clock period in which Din does not transition, Din remains equal to the value sampled into Q, so X stays LOW. For a period in which Din transitions, Q still holds the old sampled value until the next positive clock edge, while Din has changed after the delay ΔT. Therefore X is HIGH for TCK − ΔT of that period. The expected HIGH-time fraction is 0.3·(TCK − ΔT)/TCK = 0.3·(1 − 0.15). Multiply this duty factor by 3.3 V and round to two decimals.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个正边沿触发的 D Flip-Flop，输入为 D_in，时钟 CK 接到 CLK 端，输出 Q 与 D_in 一起接入 XOR 门，XOR 的输出节点标为 X。右侧波形图显示 CK 的周期为 T_CK，D_in 的跳变相对于采样时钟边沿有一个延迟间隔 ΔT，并且图中标出了 ΔT 与 T_CK。推理：若某个时钟周期内 D_in 不发生跳变，则理想触发器的 Q 保持为已采样的相同数据，D_in 与 Q 相同，XOR 输出 X 为低电平 0 V。若某个时钟周期内 D_in 发生跳变，则在跳变后的到下一个正时钟边沿之前，Q 仍保持旧值，而 D_in 已变为新值，所以 D_in 与 Q 不同，XOR 输出高电平。按给定方法，高电平持续时间为 T_CK - ΔT。已知 ΔT/T_CK = 0.15，因此发生跳变时的高电平占空比为 1 - 0.15 = 0.85。每个周期发生 D_in 跳变的概率为 0.3，所以平均高电平时间比例为 0.3 × 0.85 = 0.255。XOR 高电平电压为 3.3 V，因此 X 的平均电压为 3.3 × 0.255 = 0.8415 V，保留两位小数为 0.84 V。

method.method_draft: Choose a random clock period and a random time within it. During the first ΔT of the period, the current Din is still the value just sampled at the CK rising edge, so Din = Q and X = 0. During the remaining fraction 1 − ΔT/TCK, Din and Q differ only if the input bit actually made a transition in that period, which has probability 0.3. Thus P(X is HIGH) = (1 − 0.15)·0.3. The average node voltage is 3.3·P(X is HIGH), rounded to two decimals.
